resources.string: Saving backups to the cloud requires accepting the privacy policy and the terms of use.
Not accepting never blocks the data or exporting it: it only pauses cloud backups.
The privacy policy or the terms of use have changed. %1$s. Without accepting, backups to the cloud are paused. The app, the data on the phone and exports keep working.
What %1$s is. A tool to record the internal management of a business, which runs on the phone.
Provided as is. %1$s is offered without warranties, to the extent that applicable rules allow.
Responsibility of the user. Each person answers for their data, for what they record and for their local obligations.
What it does not replace. %1$s does not replace accounting or invoicing anywhere.
Data about other people. Whoever records customer or supplier data decides what to keep and answers for it.
Recovery code. With encryption on, if the phone and every copy of the code are lost, the data in encrypted backups cannot be recovered.
Changes. If these terms change, %1$s asks to accept them. Not accepting them never blocks the data or exporting it.
The details are in the full text
